note: Defines Cryptologic Watch tracks and maps entry ids in cryptologic.json to tracks. A track's freshness is the most recent date or updated value among its entries.

tracks.name: The Quantum Threat to Encryption
tracks.angle: Data captured today can be decrypted later. The deadline is set by how long secrets must stay secret, not by when a quantum computer arrives.
tracks.closingQuestion: What data captured today will still matter in 2040, and who decides?

tracks.name: Quantum Computing & Networks
tracks.angle: Qubit counts make headlines; error-corrected logical qubits decide outcomes. Quantum networking is a separate race with a separate verdict.

foundations.title: What a cryptographically relevant quantum computer actually means

tracks.closingQuestion: If an adversary built a cryptographically relevant quantum computer first, how would anyone know?

tracks.name: Quantum Sensing & Navigation
tracks.angle: GPS jamming and spoofing are now routine in conflict zones. Quantum sensors are a candidate fallback, mostly still at trial stage.

foundations.title: How quantum sensors navigate without satellites

tracks.closingQuestion: Does the advantage go to whoever fields first, or do new sensors bring new ways to be deceived?

tracks.name: Telecom Intrusion & Lawful Intercept
tracks.angle: Systems built for court-authorized wiretaps became a target. Salt Typhoon is the reference case.

foundations.title: Lawful intercept: how wiretap infrastructure works

tracks.closingQuestion: Does Salt Typhoon change the debate over lawful access to encrypted communications?

tracks.name: Infrastructure Pre-Positioning
tracks.angle: U.S. government advisories describe Volt Typhoon as positioning for disruption in a future crisis, not espionage. Scope limited to published CISA and FBI reporting.
tracks.closingQuestion: How do you deter an intrusion whose purpose is a crisis that has not happened yet?

tracks.name: Undersea Cables & the Seabed
tracks.angle: Nearly all intercontinental data moves on cables. Damage is frequent; attribution is slow and often contested.

foundations.title: How the cable network works and fails

tracks.closingQuestion: Where is the line between accident, gray-zone activity, and an act of war?

tracks.name: Covert Channels & Provenance
tracks.angle: Steganography hides that a message exists. Generative AI shifts the contest toward proving where content came from.
tracks.closingQuestion: In the long run, does provenance or detection win?

tracks.name: Defense-Tech Startup Radar
tracks.angle: Firms are profiled only with a public DoD, DIU, or SBIR link. Capability claims are attributed, not repeated.

foundations.title: How to read a defense-tech contract announcement

tracks.closingQuestion: Which of these firms is building something the government cannot build itself?

tracks.name: Digital Asset Security
tracks.angle: The largest thefts break operations, not cryptography. Lower priority; existing coverage retained.
tracks.closingQuestion: If the math holds and the people fail, where should security spending go?
